gaps.question: Which concrete harness produces a threshold-triggered snapshot whose index lags the log end by at least TrailingLogs, and does the peer then stay unrepairable? investigations.hypothesis: installSnapshot sets lastApplied and lastSnapshot but never calls setLastLog nor invalidates the pre-existing log entry at L. getLastEntry returns (lastLogIndex,lastLogTerm) whenever lastLogIndex >= lastSnapshotIndex, so once the snapshot makes lastSnapshotIndex == L while the stale log entry keeps lastLogIndex == L, the tie is resolved in favour of the stale log term. investigations.question: After a follower successfully installs an InstallSnapshot whose last included entry is (index L, term T), must the follower accept the leader's next AppendEntries with PrevLogEntry=L and PrevLogTerm=T, and does it still do so when the follower already held a log entry at L from an earlier term?
investigations.hypothesis: installSnapshot sets lastApplied and lastSnapshot but never calls setLastLog nor invalidates the pre-existing log entry at L. getLastEntry returns (lastLogIndex,lastLogTerm) whenever lastLogIndex >= lastSnapshotIndex, so once the snapshot makes lastSnapshotIndex == L while the stale log entry keeps lastLogIndex == L, the tie is resolved in favour of the stale log term.
